fix/4.task_description: Fix streaming mid-stream backend disconnect (issue #4): detect upstream disconnect in handler.ts, emit error event before stream close, clean up AbortController and stream-registry
fix/4.approach: Detect upstream disconnect during reader.read() and send an SSE error event to the client, then clean up the stream registry entry and propagate the error to signal mid-stream failure.
out_of_scope: Client-side reconnection retry logic (handled by AI SDK consumer)
Exponential backoff reconnection strategies (deferred to client layer)
Support for other streaming protocols beyond SSE
fix/4.risk_reason: Bug fix touching 2 files across packages/server (handler.ts and stream-registry.ts) with stream cleanup and error propagation logic that requires careful state management to avoid resource leaks or client notification failures.
